availability_at_freeze.cpu_only_fixed_action_runner: required; must be runnable without network or a paid service
availability_at_freeze.model_weights_or_provider_credentials: not available or pinned; no model run is scheduled
availability_at_freeze.qualified_solver_or_checker: not available under the authoritative validation PATH; no solver proof claim is scheduled
availability_at_freeze.live_ucan_crypto: not qualified; A3/A4 record fixture/envelope status and make no live-crypto claim
availability_at_freeze.durable_consumption_store: not qualified; restart/cross-worker replay claims are excluded
availability_at_freeze.source_manifests_and_independent_oracles: not yet frozen; execution is blocked until LA-004 and later independent-label tasks provide them

fixed_action_budget.stop_rule: Stop at the CPU ceiling or a required-dependency failure, preserve all started records, and report every unstarted/timeout/failure category.

reproducibility_requirements: immutable source, policy, handler, retrieval, and environment hashes
command, seed, configuration fingerprint, exit status, elapsed time, and raw outcome for every attempt
no user-profile toolchain or network-dependent installation in validation

closed_loop_agent: accessible model identifier and immutable weights or provider revision
solver_or_checker_claim: digest-bound deployment usable under the authoritative PATH
raw solver result and independent checker receipt
live_ucan_or_durable_replay_claim: real verifier/key material handling without secret disclosure

decision: Proceed only with the narrower CPU-only fixed-action contribution when its source/oracle dependencies are frozen. Otherwise report a capability/dependency gap and do not substitute fixtures, profile tools, hosted access, or a paid API.
